thread.title: Top 3 Apple ETFs See Results of Q1 Earnings

author: Amiya Moretta
title: Top 3 Apple ETFs See Results of Q1 Earnings
text:
Top 3 Apple ETFs See Results of Q1 Earnings May 02, 2018, 01:29:40 PM EDT By editor@etftrends.com (ETF Trends), Tom Lydon Shutterstock photo
Investors in Apple ( AAPL ) were pleasantly surprised by Apple's earning report released Tuesday, which crushed expectations and the 3 ETFs with the largest exposure to Apple are seeing the results. Apple's forecast worried Wall Street as analysts panicked when several iPhone X component suppliers gave cautionary warnings over high-end smartphone demand.
